privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: How Dicteé collects, uses, and protects personal information.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: Dicteé ("we", "us", "our") is a web application that helps families and school groups turn vocabulary lists into multiplayer learning games. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, why we collect it, how we use it, and the choices available to you.

Dicteé is designed for use by parents and guardians ("Users") who manage groups and vocabulary, and by children who play as separate "Player" profiles under parental supervision. By creating an account or using the service, you agree to this policy.

accountInfo.title: 2.1 Account information (Users / parents)
items: Username and password chosen at registration
Email address (used for group invitations and account-related messages)
Optional profile fields you choose to share with group members (e.g. display name)
Group membership, admin role, and invitation history

playerProfiles.title: 2.2 Player profiles (children)
items: Player display name and optional passphrase for session access
Group association, game participation, and scores during active sessions
Player sessions use short-lived tokens stored in the browser session until the session ends or expires

contentYouUpload.title: 2.3 Content you upload or create
items: Vocabulary lists (words, translations, notes) that you import or enter manually
Files you upload for vocabulary extraction (e.g. PDFs, photos of word lists). Images may be processed with OCR and AI-assisted structuring to build vocabulary entries
Group chat messages and system log entries visible within your group
Game state, moves, and scores generated during multiplayer sessions

technicalData.title: 2.4 Technical and usage data
items: Browser type, device information, and IP address as part of normal web server and API logs
Language preference stored locally in your browser (localStorage)
WebSocket connection metadata needed to run real-time games and group updates

howWeUse.title: 3. How we use your information
items: Create and manage User and Player accounts
Operate groups, invitations, vocabulary libraries, and multiplayer games
Send invitation emails when a group admin invites a parent by email
Extract vocabulary from uploaded documents and images
Display chat, activity logs, and game results within your group
Maintain security, troubleshoot errors, and improve reliability
Comply with applicable legal obligations
howWeUse.noSell: We do not sell your personal information. We do not use your data for third-party advertising.

childrensPrivacy.title: 4. Children's privacy
paragraphs: Player accounts are intended to be created and managed by a parent or guardian through a User account. Children should not register a User account without parental consent.

We collect only the information needed for gameplay and group participation (player name, game activity, scores). Parents control which group a child joins through invitations and can end player sessions from the parent dashboard.
If you believe we have collected personal information from a child without appropriate consent, contact us so we can review and delete the account where required.

sharing.title: 5. Sharing and third-party services
sharing.intro: We may share information in these limited situations:

items.label: Within your group:
items.text: Other members of the same group can see usernames, shared vocabulary, chat messages (according to visibility rules), and game activity

items.label: Service providers:
items.text: We use infrastructure and tools to run the app, including hosting, email delivery (SMTP), and AI/OCR services for vocabulary extraction from uploaded files. These providers process data only to perform the service on our behalf

items.label: Legal requirements:
items.text: We may disclose information if required by law or to protect the rights, safety, and security of users and the service

sharing.uploadWarning: When you upload images or documents for vocabulary import, file content may be sent to automated recognition services to detect and structure words. Do not upload documents containing sensitive personal data unrelated to vocabulary learning.

dataRetention.title: 6. Data retention
paragraphs: We retain account and group data for as long as your account or group exists, unless you request deletion or we must remove it for legal reasons. Chat logs and game history may be kept to support group administration and learning records.
Invitation tokens expire after a limited period. Player session tokens expire when the session ends or times out.

security.title: 7. Security
paragraphs: We take reasonable measures to protect information against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse, including access controls on group data and secure transport (HTTPS in production deployments).
No online service is completely secure. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for supervising children's use of Player sessions.

yourChoices.title: 8. Your choices and rights
yourChoices.intro: Depending on your location, you may have the right to:
items: Access or update your User profile information
Leave a group or delete a group you administer (subject to admin rules in the app)
Request correction or deletion of personal data we hold about you
Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent
yourChoices.contact: To exercise these rights, use in-app account and group management features or contact your group administrator.

international.title: 9. International users
paragraphs: Dicteé may be hosted and operated from servers in the region chosen by your deployment or school. If you use the service from outside that region, your information may be transferred to and processed in that location.

changes.title: 10. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will post the revised version on this page and update the "Last updated" date. Continued use of Dicteé after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.metaDescription: Terms and conditions for using the Dicteé vocabulary learning platform.

agreement.title: 1. Agreement
paragraphs: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of Dicteé, including our website, API, multiplayer games, group features, and related services ("Service"). By registering an account, joining a group, or using the Service in any way, you agree to these Terms and to our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.
If you do not agree, do not use the Service. If you are accepting these Terms on behalf of a child or organization, you represent that you have authority to do so.

items.label: Users (parents/guardians):
items.text: Must be old enough to enter a binding agreement in their jurisdiction (typically 18 or the age of majority). Users manage groups, vocabulary, invitations, and Player profiles.

items.label: Players (children):
items.text: May use Player profiles created under a User account. Players access games through session links or passphrases provided by a parent or group admin.

items.label: Groups:
items.text: Access is invitation-only. You may only join groups to which you have been invited or that you create yourself.

accountsAndSecurity.title: 3. Accounts and security
items: Provide accurate registration information and keep it up to date
Maintain the confidentiality of your password and player session credentials
Notify your group admin or account owner if you suspect unauthorized access
Accept responsibility for activity under your account unless you report misuse promptly
accountsAndSecurity.suspension: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms or pose a risk to other users.

acceptableUse.title: 4. Acceptable use
acceptableUse.intro: You may not use Dicteé to:
items: Harass, bully, or threaten other users, especially minors
Upload unlawful, offensive, or sexually explicit content
Upload personal data of third parties without permission (beyond vocabulary learning materials)
Attempt to bypass security, scrape the Service, or disrupt games or servers
Impersonate another person or misrepresent your affiliation with a group
Use automated bots to play games or spam group chat
Reverse engineer or resell the Service except as permitted by applicable open-source licenses
acceptableUse.moderation: Group admins may remove members who breach group rules. We may remove content or restrict access at our discretion to protect the community.

userContent.title: 5. User content and vocabulary
paragraphs: You retain ownership of vocabulary lists, messages, and other content you submit ("User Content"). By submitting User Content, you grant Dicteé a non-exclusive, worldwide license to host, store, display, and process that content solely to operate the Service for you and your group—including OCR and AI-assisted extraction when you upload files.
You represent that you have the right to upload User Content and that it does not infringe third-party intellectual property or privacy rights.

groupsAndInvitations.title: 6. Groups, invitations, and admin actions
paragraphs: Group creators become administrators with tools to invite members, manage vocabulary, moderate chat visibility, and remove members. Admin actions (expulsions, promotions, group deletion) are logged in the group activity feed where configured.
Invitations sent by email include a unique link. Do not share invitation links publicly; they are intended for specific recipients invited to your class or family group.

gamesAndMultiplayer.title: 7. Games and multiplayer features
paragraphs: Multiplayer games rely on real-time connections. We do not guarantee uninterrupted availability. Scores and game outcomes are stored for display within your group session. Game rules are defined in the application; disputes between players should be resolved by parents or group admins.
"Play Now" player sessions are time-limited. Parents are responsible for ending sessions and supervising online play.

thirdPartyServices.title: 8. Third-party services
paragraphs: The Service may integrate email delivery, optical character recognition, and language models to process uploaded vocabulary materials. Your use of those features is also subject to the policies of the underlying providers where applicable.

disclaimer.title: 9. Disclaimer of warranties
paragraphs: THE SERVICE IS PROVIDED "AS IS" AND "AS AVAILABLE" WITHOUT WARRANTIES OF ANY KIND, WHETHER EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE, AND NON-INFRINGEMENT.

We do not warrant that the Service will be error-free, secure, or suitable for every educational context. Vocabulary extracted automatically from photos or PDFs may contain errors; always review imported lists before use in class or homework.

limitationOfLiability.title: 10. Limitation of liability
paragraphs: TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW, DICTEÉ AND ITS CONTRIBUTORS WILL NOT BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES, OR ANY LOSS OF DATA, PROFITS, OR GOODWILL, ARISING FROM YOUR USE OF THE SERVICE.

Our total liability for any claim relating to the Service is limited to the amount you paid us for the Service in the twelve months before the claim, or zero if the Service is provided free of charge.

termination.title: 11. Termination
paragraphs: You may stop using the Service at any time. Group admins may delete groups they manage. We may suspend or terminate access if you violate these Terms or if continued operation poses legal or security risks.
Sections that by their nature should survive termination (including disclaimers, limitation of liability, and governing law) will remain in effect.

changesToTerms.title: 12. Changes to the Service and Terms
paragraphs: We may modify features or these Terms from time to time. Material changes will be posted on this page with an updated date. Your continued use after changes become effective constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

governingLaw.title: 13. Governing law
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by the laws applicable in the jurisdiction of the organization operating this Dicteé deployment, without regard to conflict-of-law principles. Courts in that jurisdiction will have exclusive venue for disputes, unless mandatory consumer protection laws in your country require otherwise.

contact.title: 14. Contact
paragraphs: For questions about these Terms, contact your group administrator or the team responsible for hosting this Dicteé instance.
